findings: Retry delivery test verifies the document reaches the real Solr test server after an injected failure, but only checks that an error names the stalled node. Require the stall IOException/message to distinguish a transport failure; its first failure is synchronously injected, so it is not proof of an async failing-stream callback.

Real socket error callback test checks only a nonempty error list despite sending 503. Assert target node and expected status or cause so a connection or request-stream failure cannot satisfy the assertion. The raw socket does not consume the request; verify stability.

Concurrent drain test does not force an insertion between old snapshot and clear, so passing does not establish race discrimination. The existing gate requires a controlled interleaving; a permanent deterministic test would need a suitable seam or infrastructure.

JavaBin test checks valid RF and rollup. Real socket test exercises a real runner while holding the client monitor but does not invoke blockUntilFinished concurrently. Queued-write/recovery safety remains unproven.
